data.fullPrompt: cvwmn interior photograph: Framed vintage suzani textile art 48x36 inches in walnut shadowbox centered above bed at 57 inches from floor, hand-embroidered silk in terracotta indigo goldenrod. Brass arc floor lamp behind bed left corner arcing 6ft high casting warm amber diagonal glow across headboard wall at 2700K. Floor-to-ceiling heavyweight European linen curtains in burnt ochre hung at ceiling height on brass rod puddling 2 inches on floor. Fiddle leaf fig in woven seagrass basket with leather trim positioned floor between bed and window at 5ft height. Bed platform with terracotta linen duvet, rust silk-velvet lumbar pillow, ochre cashmere throw draped diagonally. Shot on Canon EOS R5 35mm f/2.8 ISO 400. cvwmn, Architectural Digest editorial photograph, photorealistic interior design render.
